title: Modular Generators for Massive Double Cones
exact_target: Determine whether the double-cone modular-generator component for a massive scalar field is mass independent and acts by multiplication.

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath, record 30005723 (OWR-14298009-001). Catalogue curation under CC BY 4.0; definitions and English exposition added locally.
Mini-Workshop: Standard Subspaces in Quantum Field Theory and Representation Theory (2023), Oberwolfach Reports, DOI 10.4171/owr/2023/50, pp. 2851--2901. Original report and mathematical context.

status_qualification: The decomposition defining $M_-$ is source-specific. Mass independence of this component would not automatically imply mass independence of the entire modular flow.
